posts.author: Idelac
posts.body:
So, two questions about the weapon image files.
In the RPG Maker MV asset standards, there's no size given for how big a frame for a weapon animation should be. So, how large should each frame be? 64x32? 96x64? What?
Also, I'm curious how the size difference in adult and child battlers handles the weapon sprites when using basic attacks. Is the weapon sprite moved down into the child's hand to accommodate the height difference, or is it the other way around?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Idelac said:
In the RPG Maker MV asset standards, there's no size given for how big a frame for a weapon animation should be. So, how large should each frame be? 64x32? 96x64? What?
Click to expand...
If you hover your mouse over the image file in Windows, it says it's 576 pixels across. Divide that by the 6 visible cels, and you get 96 pixels each.
Same thing for the 384 pixel height divided by 6 cels vertically to get 64. So 96x64.
And, of course, if you just open it in an image editor you can create that grid to see it fits.
Idelac said:
Also, I'm curious how the size difference in adult and child battlers handles the weapon sprites when using basic attacks. Is the weapon sprite moved down into the child's hand to accommodate the height difference, or is it the other way around?
Click to expand...
What would the other way around be? That the child's hand reaches higher on its body than the adult arms do? Seems like you should be able to look at the body image files to compare that
I just toggled between the Male, Female, and Kid tabs of the character generator. Yes, the kid reaches up and the weapon is drawn in the same place relative to the sprite.
